identity.title: Public Population Batch Diagnostics And Market Status Normalization Repair
identity.objective: Repair the merged WP164 bounded public-population layer before any S10-GATE-AF1 Attempt-03: retain the complete typed WP156 batch-validation result, preserve truthful stage counts on later rejection, normalize live Gamma lifecycle booleans into the exact open/closed vocabulary required by downstream Alpha discovery, and prove the 25-market/1-book path offline. Phase A performs zero public-market calls. A later one-call public smoke remains separately authorized and non-retryable.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert WP164A. The additive WP164 batch-diagnostic result fields, truthful rejection-stage counts, population-local open/closed normalization, focused tests, contract/status/spec records and repo-truth updates disappear. No AF1 branch, Hermes, credentials, scheduler, trading, dependency or workflow state is created by Phase A; any separately authorized public-smoke local artifacts remain noncanonical audit material only.

api_matrix.reason: WP164A makes three bounded compatibility changes to the existing WP164 public-population surface and does not add another population API.

items.before: POPULATION_BATCH_INVALID exposes only the WP164 umbrella error; the completed PointInTimeBatchValidationResult is discarded.
items.after: The public result adds nullable/empty additive fields that copy the complete completed WP156 batch result: is_valid, status, errors, warnings, accepted ids, exact-duplicate ids, quarantined ids and canonical batch hash.
items.compatibility_requirement: Existing fields and public functions remain; new fields have fail-closed defaults for paths that never complete batch validation; no raw payload or exception text is exposed.

items.before: The generic _PopulationReject catch path can return zero fetched/built counts even after earlier stages completed.
items.after: Already-known fetched-market, fetched-book and successfully-built-record counts survive later rejection; unexecuted stages remain zero and inserted count changes only after committed append.
items.compatibility_requirement: Counts describe completed stages only and never substitute for persistence or validator evidence.

items.before: WP164 copies MarketSummary.market_status, while the public parser converts Gamma active via str(...), so boolean true can become the noncanonical string True.
items.after: WP164 derives market_status directly from raw Gamma lifecycle booleans: closed is exactly true -> closed; active is exactly true and closed is exactly false -> open; every other combination rejects POPULATION_RESPONSE_INVALID.
items.compatibility_requirement: PolymarketPublicClient is unchanged, AF1 eligible statuses are unchanged, and no market is inferred open from price or book activity.

semantic_fields.reason: The repair must expose exact closed diagnostics and normalize lifecycle state without weakening WP156 or broadening runtime authority.

items.required_rule: After a completed validate_record_batch call, copy the complete typed result into additive WP164 result fields: batch_is_valid, batch_status, batch_error_codes, batch_warning_codes, batch_accepted_record_version_ids, batch_exact_duplicate_record_version_ids, batch_quarantined_record_version_ids and canonical_batch_sha256.
items.validation_rule: No completed typed batch field is dropped or truncated; paths that never complete validation use only null/empty defaults; POPULATION_BATCH_INVALID remains the outer WP164 rejection.

items.required_rule: fetched_market_count is fixed immediately after successful Gamma GET; fetched_order_book_count increments after each successful CLOB GET before normalization; built_record_count increments after each successful record build; inserted_record_count changes only after append commits.
items.validation_rule: Later rejection preserves already-known counts and never infers counts for stages not reached.

items.required_rule: raw closed is exactly true -> closed; else raw active is exactly true and raw closed is exactly false -> open; every other lifecycle combination rejects POPULATION_RESPONSE_INVALID.
items.validation_rule: No str(True)/str(False), no alternate fallback state, no AF1 eligibility widening, and no inference from order-book or price data.
items.safe_output: open or closed, otherwise closed rejection

items.required_rule: Phase A implementation, tests, CI and validation perform zero real Polymarket/public-product calls; only fake/in-memory transports are permitted.
items.validation_rule: Any real public-market call before the separate smoke authorization is an authority violation.

items.required_rule: A later separately authorized WP164A smoke uses a fresh local workspace, atomically creates a pre-call invocation sentinel, permits exactly one 25-market/1-book WP164 invocation, immediately persists the complete typed result, and never retries the same workspace.
items.validation_rule: Existing sentinel means zero new call; process failure after sentinel consumes the workspace; another call requires a new human authorization and fresh workspace.

items.required_rule: S10-GATE-AF1 Attempt-03 remains unauthorized and its existing branch/workspaces are not modified by WP164A.
items.validation_rule: No AF1 population, Hermes call, branch edit, rebase or attempt-03 authorization occurs in this WP Phase A.
